_doc: engine.208 dial 9 seed overrides — AUTHORED fandom base values (builder ruling 2026-10-02 23:29: families and any canon fan are seeded as fans). Read by the seed pass (plan §2.3 of docs/research/2026-10-02-engine-208-fandom-dial-read-before.md); everyone not listed stays at 50 + wager/zone/household terms. Evidence = the citizen's own Supermemory page (container citizen-pages, listed 2026-10-02, 2,077 docs, 604 sports-matching, 66 with team-level hits) or an audited edition ingest (bay-tribune). Band: 60-65 = a real fan (band 3 floor/mid), 70 = plans around games, 85 = lives and dies. Resolve by POPID; names are for the reader.
_excluded_on_purpose: GAME-clock athletes/coaches/GM (the subject, dial inert — ruling i); beat reporters Selena Grant, Talia Finch, Tanya Cruz, Anthony Raines (professional coverage, not fandom); Vinnie-relationship mentions with no team content (Warren Ashford, Vanessa Tran-Munoz, Depak Ying, Xavier Ramington); 'Coliseum District' development mentions (a place, not a game); POP-00801 Maurice Franklin — Edition 91 calls him a 63-year-old retired transit supervisor and A's fan, the ledger row is a Drone Fleet Coordinator in care since C106: same name, different person — not seeded.
